queries.label: Recovery rate by branch
queries.sql:
SELECT branch,
       round(sum(cost)) AS billable_spend,
       round(sum(recovered)) AS recovered,
       round(100 * sum(recovered) / sum(cost), 1) AS recovery_pct
FROM shipments
WHERE billable
GROUP BY branch
ORDER BY recovery_pct;

queries.label: Where unrecovered freight goes
queries.sql:
SELECT recovery_status,
       count(*) AS shipments,
       round(sum(cost - recovered)) AS unrecovered
FROM shipments
WHERE billable
GROUP BY recovery_status
ORDER BY unrecovered DESC;

queries.label: Charge-to-cost by carrier, 2024
queries.sql:
SELECT carrier,
       quarter(ship_date) AS qtr,
       round(sum(charged) / sum(cost), 3) AS charge_to_cost
FROM shipments
WHERE year(ship_date) = 2024
  AND recovery_status IN ('Charged', 'Charged, then credited')
GROUP BY ALL
ORDER BY carrier, qtr;

queries.label: Waiver rate by branch
queries.sql:
SELECT branch,
       round(100 * avg(CASE WHEN recovery_status = 'Waived: discretionary' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS waiver_pct,
       count(*) AS chargeable_shipments
FROM shipments
WHERE recovery_status IN ('Charged', 'Charged, then credited', 'Waived: discretionary')
GROUP BY branch
ORDER BY waiver_pct DESC;

queries.label: Freight as % of order value
queries.sql:
SELECT CASE WHEN order_value < 100 THEN '1 · under $100'
            WHEN order_value < 250 THEN '2 · $100–249'
            WHEN order_value < 750 THEN '3 · $250–749'
            ELSE '4 · $750+ (ships free)' END AS order_band,
       count(*) AS shipments,
       round(100 * median(cost / order_value), 1) AS median_freight_pct
FROM shipments
WHERE billable
GROUP BY order_band
ORDER BY order_band;
